system.description:
“It’s not about throwing hard. It’s about throwing smart.” You are a ranged prodigy who has perfected the art of the thrown weapon, striking multiple targets with a single throw, and always landing the perfect shot.

LEVEL 3

Master Thrower.

Your Vicious Opportunist feature now applies to attacks you make with thrown weapons against Distracted targets. Your thrown weapons gain +4 Reach. You may sheathe and draw daggers & improvised weapons for free.

Improviser.

Anything small enough (and dangerous enough) that you can hold becomes a thrown weapon. Your improvised weapons deal 1d4+DEX and have the Light and Thrown properties. Additionally, you always seem to have at least 2xLVL “things” within reach to throw.

LEVEL 7

Ricochet Shot.

(INT/Safe Rest) When you hit a creature with a thrown weapon attack, a second target in Range 4 of the first takes damage equal to your Sneak attack die.

LEVEL 11

Interceptive Shot.

(INT/Safe Rest) Reaction: When an ally in Range 8 is attacked by a Ranged weapon. The attack has disadvantage. If it misses, you can make a free thrown weapon attack against the attacker if they are in Range of you.

LEVEL 15

Impossible Angle.

(1/Field Rest) 1 Action. You can make a thrown weapon attack against a target you are aware of in Range 8 regardless of Cover. This attack is made with advantage and if it hits, it deals your normal weapon damage and your maximum possible Sneak Attack damage automatically.

Underhanded Abilities

Grappling Hook! 1 Action. Fire a tether up to 12 spaces leaving a rope behind. Allies can use an Action to travel the length of the rope.

Press the Advantage. When you successfully hit a Distracted target, you can immediately make a second attack for free against that same creature.

Hamstringer. When you hit a creature with your Sneak Attack, you can choose to forgo half your Sneak Attack damage die (rounded down). If you do, the target’s speed is reduced to 0, 1 turn.

Temple Strike. When you hit a creature with your Sneak attack, you can choose to forgo half your Sneak Attack damage die (rounded down). If you do, the target is Blinded, Stunned and Deafened 2 turns.
